11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager is pleased a friend was recognized for a discovery, but wishes their own help had been mentioned.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is pleased that (friend) has received recognition for an important discovery. Truly pleased. (subject.He/She) helped with the research and knows how hard (friend) worked. Still, a small, uncomfortable part of (subject) wishes someone had mentioned (subject.his/her) contribution too.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I helped with the early experiments," (subject) says quietly. (friend) looks surprised. "Of course you did! I should have mentioned that." At the next gathering, (friend) acknowledges the assistance. (subject) appreciates it, although the earlier disappointment hasn't vanished completely.

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (a thing, a sound or a worry disappears); nobody goes missing

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) joins the celebration and congratulates (friend). Later, alone, (subject.he/she) admits to feeling both proud and envious. It is an uncomfortable combination, but an honest one.

text_only.reason: a celebration in the story (a feast, a moment of joy); no village celebration happens in the game
